content: Jakva lava dǝ tukh

Fitsa tlǝrna, ka dala Yasu da tǝghay dǝlv, ka gwidǝn farsa tsagatǝrdu tsaga tsin kǝ udakh. Dzakhava udakhe a tsarghǝrana zikǝn itar char. Wirva yana, ba da tsin da peryuwa ndzǝgan ǝmb. Dzakhava udakh daghan tsuguna ǝn ghitsǝn tǝghay gǝrdz.
A tsagatǝrdu ad dǝgitakh zikǝn dǝ jakva lavakh. Ka niya tsitar,
“Bambǝg tlim, tsǝnam tsǝn, dadak wusa a dala da tukhǝn gukh sar.
Madǝvin ǝn kwazdu khulfa, yakhaya ɓalal da tǝ ɗul, ka sa ɗikakha vaɗu itar.
Yakhaya tsuguna ɓalala da tǝ vake dǝ jajǝrkh, vake kwal dǝ khay char. Ka fǝtsawal itar kujaɗ kujaɗ, wirva vakena na khay chara bi.
Tǝvga kǝ fatsiya, ka ɓayandal ad khiyakhen, ka ghulala itar. Wirva tlǝla tara, a dagh ba da khay chara bi.
Yakhaya kǝ khulf tsuguna, ɓaldagh itar da tak. Ka ɗakala takena, ɓidzatǝrǝf. Ka yiga ba itar zǝr bi.

Yakhaya kǝ khulf tsuguna, ɓalala itar da tǝ dǝlɓ. Fǝtsawala tsitara, ka ɗakala itar, yiga itar zǝr ndǝkchiɓ. Yakhaya yige tar zǝr kulkhǝkǝrɗ kulkhǝkǝrɗ. Yakhaya tsuguna kulunkwakh kulunkwakh. Yakhaya tsuguna dǝrmǝk dǝrmǝk.”
A mbasana Yasu ad kwar lav sar dǝ kwarne, “Ɗaga ude dǝ tlǝm tsǝn lava, tsǝnin.”
Madǝv Yasu ǝn ndzǝgan tukuɗa tukuɗa, furakh sar na kǝlatǝm mits, zǝ liye a tsarghǝran, ka ndiɗarwal itar ad dǝge ǝn tuku jakva lavakhen.
Ka niya tsitar, “Kura a khayakurnǝfud ad tsa ɓǝghan na kǝ dǝge tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝksa Yazhigǝl. Ak yakhaye kwal nǝg ǝn kura, itsauɗa ǝn kwaratǝrǝn jakva lavud.
Ki zǝɗa,

content.text: “ ‘Ən vaza vaza itara, ǝn nǝgha ba itar bi,
zǝn tsǝna tsǝna itara, ǝn diyarsǝf bai tar bi
Ki khek katlga tsitar, pǝlga itar ghǝr, ɓisatǝrna Yazhigǝl ad khaipakh tar.’ ”

content: Tsuguna ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Ai da katlga ba kur ad dǝge ǝn tuku inana kǝ jakva lava bi, ai da katla ndar kur ad dǝge ǝn tuku tlǝrna jakva lavakhi?
Auna dǝge ǝn tuku jakva lavan. Khulfe a kwazdu dadak tukha, in lav Yazhigǝl.
Khulfakhe a ɓalal da tǝ ɗul, ǝn mǝdla jakva udakhe a tsǝna lav Yazhigǝl. Ba itar ǝn tsǝna lavana, ǝn dǝvǝn dǝva, ka sagh Shatana khutsala dǝ lave ǝn rǝvakhuɗ tar.
Khulfe a ɓalala da tǝ jajǝrkh, ǝn mǝdla jakva udakhe a tsǝna lav Yazhigǝl, ka chauge tar kujaɗ kujaɗ, dǝ khwaɗǝg tsugun.
Fatsiya a tsǝga ba itar ad tlǝl bi, uk da zulu da tǝ sart khǝɗikǝn itar. Da ka sagh dlaɗa awana mbakhǝl, kǝ wirva fadǝghǝro dǝ lav Yazhigǝl, ka gwiyal itar da tǝlg kujaɗ kujaɗ.
Khulfe a ɓaldagh da tak, ǝn mǝdla jakva udakhe a tsǝna lav Yazhigǝl.
Ai wirva puta giɗǝn larda, zǝ valdu ghǝr gat tluwandala, zǝ nagh dǝgakh lard sikh sikh sikh, ka ɓidzanǝf ad laven. Ka na dǝge ǝn tukuwin bi.

Khulfe ɓalal ǝn tǝ vak duɓan, ǝn mǝdla jakva udakhe a tsǝna lav Yazhigǝl, chauge tar, mangga itar tlǝr din. Ka yige tar zǝr, kulkhǝkǝrɗ kulkhǝkǝrɗ. Yakhaya, kulunkwakh kulunkwakh. Yakhaya tsuguna, dǝrmǝk dǝrmǝk, ak khulfe a kwazduwud.
Jakva lava dǝ kara kazaz
Ka zuvuk Yasu dǝ kwarne, “Ən vǝdza kara kazaz khud ka barsud ǝn kus kǝ gagaya? Awana ǝn kus kǝ pin khǝngana? Nabakhud ǝn bǝga bǝg ǝn vak bǝgan sara?
Dǝge ɓǝghanud, da ɓadala ɓud da tǝ ɓal. Dǝge kwargud bǝghanyan, da ɓado ɓud da tǝ ɓal.
Ude dǝ tlim tsǝn lava, tsǝnin.”
Ka kwara tǝrkhai tsugun kwarne, “Bamaru tlim kǝ dǝge ǝn tsǝna kur. Darame ǝn kuradakha dǝgit kǝ udakh din, din da kura kha dud. Da gwidǝn kurakha dinud mal kǝ yan.
Ude dina, da banargher bugud zikǝn. Ude kwal dina, ngwaɗa khǝɗike dinin, da chawarval chawud.”
Jakva lava dǝ khulfe a fǝtsawal ǝn gukh
Ka nǝv Yasu tsugun, “Nggwaɗe na tlǝksa gharazhigǝl. Nggwaɗa ude a kwazdu khulf ǝn gukh.
Khana zǝ tǝkhul, ǝn fǝtsa khulfena ka ɗak. In tsuguna ǝn tsa ba dǝ ɗule ǝn fǝtsda khulfen zǝ ɗaka bi.
Khayen dǝ ghǝr sar ǝn bǝgan ad khulfen da fǝtsa, zǝ ɗaka, sǝkhadal ad ghǝr, ka yigan ad zǝr.
Ba dǝgwayen ǝn tǝkhala tǝkh, ka da zǝɓ gidz kǝ da tsǝga tsǝg, wirva a tlala sarta tsǝg khi.”
Jakva lava dǝ khulf Mastad
Ka nǝv Yasu tsugun, “Uɗa da kwara kiyami? Da kura dǝ uɗa kiyam ad tlǝksa Yazhigǝli? Awana, ira kǝ jakva lave da kurada kiyam mana sari?
Nggwaɗa khulf mastad, ai khǝɗikan ǝn daghan khulfakhe ǝn tukhud ǝn lard.
Dǝmbiyanen, da tukhgud, ǝn ɗaka mal kǝ dǝgakhe ǝn wusud ǝn nggaɓ. Ən bakh gwal char, ai da tǝkha ɗikakh kǝ ndzǝgan ǝn kus kǝ sǝɗikw sar.
Dǝ khulf ina kǝ jakva lavakh zikǝn, a kwara tǝrkhai Yasu ad lava Yazhigǝl kǝ udakh. Kalkal ɗule da katlda itar.
Na dǝge a kwara tǝrkhayin kwal dǝ jakva lava bi. Ən sarte da tukuɗa tukuɗa itar zǝ furakh sar, ǝn kwaratra kwara dǝge ǝn tuku laven.
A ghitsana Yasu ad kalanggas yu
Ɓǝlga kǝ khagw fitsa yanen, ka nǝv Yasu kǝ furakh sar, “Dziyamal da tǝ yan kǝ ghǝdzǝva gadzak.”
Ɗuwars itar ad dzakhava udakh, ka dagh furakh sar da peryuwe ǝn ndzǝgan Yasu ǝmb. Nǝg tlǝrna peryuwakh tsugun zitar.
Ka soghǝr zikan kǝ fuɗ char ǝn yuwen, ǝn tlǝga tlǝga ghǝɗkuta yuwa ad peryuwen. Ən daks yu da peryu, tǝmga khǝɗikǝn kǝ righa righ.
Ən khǝnkhar Yasu ǝn tǝlg kǝ peryu, ka bo ad ghǝr sar ǝn tǝ dǝg ɓǝl ghǝre kurɓǝt. Ka tsiyanǝf furakh sar, ka ndiɗarwal itar kwarne, “Malǝma, na ɗangwa tsǝkha itsa ndǝkiyamu yuwa, ǝmtsǝga kiyam biya?
Ka tsiyif ǝn khar, tavarghǝr ad di kǝ fuɗen. Ka niya kǝ ghǝɗkuta yu, “Ghitsga ghits.” Ka ghitsga fuɗen. Ka ɗiw nǝv vaken.
Ka niya kǝ furakh sar, “Uɗa lava tsukur a gǝdzǝf ndǝkyani? Sakhkana na kur dǝ fadǝghǝrofǝg biya?”
Ka gǝdzǝf itar char. Ka ndiɗakava tsitar kwarne, “Khulf ira kǝ ud ineni? Zǝva, fuɗa zǝ ghǝɗkutayuwa ǝn tsǝnaru tsǝn kǝ lav sari?”
